test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. I had reached the most exciting part of my Agatha Christie novel.

B. He was presently gruelling the Duchess seated in the arm chair.

C. Hercule Poirot had managed to get together all his suspects in one room and in his great style was cornering them into confession.

D. She had become extremely nervous and was on the verge of a breakdown.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ACBD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• Sentence A will be the first sentence because it contains the main idea of the para jumble. It tells us about an exciting part of 'Agatha Christie novel'.
 
• Sentence C will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence and further tells us the story of the novel and Hercule Poirot.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, Sentence D will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• A: I had reached the most exciting part of my Agatha Christie novel.
 
• C: Hercule Poirot had managed to get together all his suspects in one room and in his great style was cornering them into confession.
 
• B: He was presently gruelling the Duchess seated in the arm chair.
 
• D: She had become extremely nervous and was on the verge of a breakdown.

 
 
 
 
 

Correct Sequence:__* I had reached the most exciting part of my Agatha Christie novel. Hercule Poirot had managed to get together all his suspects in one room and in his great style was cornering them into confession. He was presently gruelling the Duchess seated in the arm chair. She had become extremely nervous and was on the verge of a breakdown.*
